quote.quote: Meeting of the Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee was convened to discuss whether the applicant provided substantial evidence of the safety and effectiveness of plazomicin for the treatment of cUTI and/or BSIs in patients with limited or no treatment options.

meeting_date.text: May 2, 2018 (RiskR and MedR report May 2, 2018; the SumR states May 03, 2018 — a one-day discrepancy across review documents)

quote.quote: 05/02/2018: Meeting of the Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee was convened

recommendation.text: The committee voted 15-0 that substantial evidence of safety and effectiveness was provided for the cUTI indication, and voted 11-4 against the bloodstream infection (BSI) indication.

quote.quote: The AC voted in favor of the cUTI indication and voted against the indication for BSIs.

linkages.concern: The committee voted 11-4 against the bloodstream infection (BSI) indication, finding the applicant had not provided substantial evidence of safety and effectiveness of plazomicin for treatment of BSIs.
linkages.change: The approval was limited to complicated urinary tract infection (cUTI); only the cUTI trial results were included in the label, and the BSI indication was not granted.

concern_quote.quote: The AC voted in favor of the cUTI indication and voted against the indication for BSIs.

change_quote.quote: Only the results of the cUTI trials are included in the Adverse Reactions and Clinical Studies section of the label.

linkages.concern: Many committee members were concerned that the issues around plazomicin trough measurements for prevention of nephrotoxicity had not been fully resolved and needed to be explicitly explained in labeling.
linkages.change: Labeling includes recommendations for therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) to keep trough concentrations below 3 mcg/mL in patients with reduced creatinine clearance.

concern_quote.quote: there was concern by many members that the issues regarding plazomicin trough measurements for the prevention of nephrotoxicity had not been fully explored/resolved and would need to be explicitly explained in labelling.

change_quote.quote: labeling will include recommendations for TDM in patients with creatinine clearance

linkages.concern: The committee recommended consideration of a postmarketing requirement to address the trough (nephrotoxicity) monitoring issue.
linkages.change: A postmarketing commitment was established to develop an FDA cleared/approved in-vitro diagnostic device for therapeutic drug monitoring of plazomicin.

concern_quote.quote: There were also recommendations to consider a PMR in order to address the trough issue.

change_quote.quote: Establish an FDA cleared or approved in-vitro diagnostic device for therapeutic drug monitoring of plazomicin

summary: The Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee (AMDAC) met on May 2, 2018 and voted 15-0 that plazomicin (ZEMDRI) had substantial evidence of safety and effectiveness for complicated urinary tract infection (cUTI) but voted 11-4 against the bloodstream infection (BSI) indication; the approval was accordingly limited to cUTI, with only cUTI trial results in the label. Committee concerns about unresolved trough/nephrotoxicity monitoring were reflected in labeling recommendations for therapeutic drug monitoring and a postmarketing commitment to develop an in-vitro diagnostic device for TDM. The verbatim AdComm transcript is not in paperclip; these findings are drawn from the FDA review documents' accounts of the meeting.
